events.summary: Baseline review of the ListenBrainz Community Pulse reference: exact package bytes, context and health descriptors, declared ListenBrainz host, privacy-minimal aggregate endpoints, synthetic fixtures, provenance and tests were checked for 0.1.0.
limitations: Listen/listener counts reflect ListenBrainz participation and should not be interpreted as total global consumption or a measure of artistic quality.
Popularity aggregates can change or lag and the extension intentionally uses a short cache lifetime.
Runtime process isolation is not a complete operating-system sandbox.
